job.title: Sr. Software Engineer - Patient Services (Remote)
job.description: As a Senior Software Engineer on our Patient Services team, you won’t just maintain existing systems—you will architect the high-throughput, distributed platform that serves as the single source of truth for all patient data across Rula. We are currently undergoing a period of hyper-scale, and you will lead the technical strategy for one of our highest-impact initiatives: re-engineering our core backend data systems to be massively scalable, resilient, and fault-tolerant.
responsibilities: Architect and re-engineer highly scalable, resilient backend data systems supporting patient services
Lead distributed systems strategy and make architectural decisions
Improve performance and reliability of systems
Mentor engineers and establish operational practices
Collaborate with product managers and cross-functional stakeholders to shape engineering and product direction
